name: Sewn Together
source:
No one really gets Elsa's need for certainty and how much she'd give of herself to find it. Perhaps there's a corner somewhere with people who do.

Join Elsa on her first date with six women sharing one body.

[From [url=https://demonward.itch.io/sewn-together]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
没有人真正理解艾尔莎为何如此渴求确定感，也不明白为了寻获这份笃定她究竟愿意献出多少自我。或许在世间某个角落里，正有能够懂她的人在等待。

跟随艾尔莎赴一场特别的初次约会——约会对象是共用同一具身体的六位女性。

[摘自[url=https://demonward.itch.io/sewn-together]itch.io[/url]]
